correctness.rationale: The continued fraction gives the exact reflection amplitude. Four zero-jet equations reduce to three real rational constraints and a positive rational interface coupling. Executed interval-contraction certificate verifies a strictly mapped 1e-7 positive box (Jacobian-defect infinity norm <0.0002, center preconditioned residual <1e-11), hence an actual positive solution. It separately certifies the numerator fourth derivative bounded away from zero and denominator -2i at the center. Taylor theorem yields precise eighth-order reflectance. No extrapolation from finite numerical scans.
